content: Radix UI (react-dialog v1.1.20 npm): 30+ primitives, acquired by WorkOS, slower cadence. Base UI (@base-ui-components/react v1.0.0-rc.0 on npm as of 2026-07-15, maintained by MUI full-time, 35 components, render-prop composition instead of asChild, built-in RTL): shadcn/ui defaults to Base UI for new projects as of July 2026 though not yet GA on npm (still rc). React Aria (react-aria-components v1.19.0 npm) by Adobe: hook-based, deepest accessibility/i18n coverage, best for locale-aware date pickers/RTL-heavy or contractually-WCAG-conformant products.
